researchHypothesis: If externally observable machine/ball-set eras can be reconstructed without using draw outcomes, then outcome distributions may be tested within and across eras for reproducible mechanical bias. No era may be inferred from winning numbers themselves.
requiredEraEvidence: official draw video or image showing stable distinguishable equipment characteristics
date-bounded change point established independently of outcomes
plannedTests: within-era per-number frequency with multiple-testing correction
forward validation on later draws from same externally-defined era
